repo-arch-explorer.purpose: Map architecture, module boundaries, and critical entry points.
must_do: Identify critical files and why they are critical.
must_not: Do not speculate without path-level evidence.

pipeline-explorer.purpose: Map build, test, and release workflow; locate quality risks.
must_do: Document local dev commands and CI command parity.
Call out quality gate gaps with file/line evidence.
must_not: Do not propose generic process changes without repository evidence.

data-worker.purpose: Implement data layer and collection logic changes.
must_do: Keep provider and storage interfaces backward compatible unless explicitly requested.
Add or update data-layer tests when behavior changes.
must_not: Do not change CI files unless delegated.

dataset-feature-worker.purpose: Implement dataset handler/processor and feature pipeline changes.
must_do: Preserve dataset split semantics unless task explicitly changes them.
Include tests for feature pipeline behavior changes.
must_not: Do not edit backtest or workflow modules.
Do not edit CI and packaging files.

must_do: Keep model serialization and recorder behavior stable by default.
Add tests for changed trainer/model behavior.
must_not: Do not edit qlib/workflow unless explicitly approved as cross-boundary work.
Do not modify data collector scripts.

backtest-worker.purpose: Implement strategy and backtest engine changes.
must_do: Protect execution semantics and default strategy behavior.
Include regression coverage for changed execution paths.
must_not: Do not edit model training internals.

workflow-online-worker.purpose: Implement workflow orchestration and online update logic.
must_do: Keep offline and online manager contracts explicit.
Update rolling tests for schedule/online behavior changes.
must_not: Do not edit backtest execution modules unless delegated.

must_do: Preserve environment-policy interaction contracts unless task requires a change.
Add RL tests for behavior and data queue changes.
must_not: Do not edit core backtest modules unless delegated.
Do not modify packaging workflow files.

tooling-ci-worker.purpose: Improve Makefile, CI, and developer workflow docs.
must_do: Keep commands reproducible locally and in CI.
Document behavior changes in developer docs.
must_not: Do not edit qlib runtime modules.
Do not change release credentials handling.
